skill.name: expense-sync
skill.description: Sync Wise transactions into the expense ledger.

attachment.anyPhrases: sync expenses,sync expense,import transactions,fetch wise,wise transactions

skill.sync_intent:
0. If `expense-ledger-schema` is not already in the prompt or tool history, call `read_skill("expense-ledger-schema")` in the same turn as step 1 (do not wait for a separate turn). 1. Parallel: `get_categories()` + `fetch_wise_transactions(since, until)` 2. `exec_sql` multi-row INSERT:
INSERT INTO public.expense (name, amount, category, paid_date, paid) VALUES (...), (...) ON CONFLICT (name, amount, paid_date) DO NOTHING;
- Round amounts up to integer - `paid_date` = Wise `createdOn` (`YYYY-MM-DD`); `paid = true` for completed outward - Map each row using `` from `expense-ledger-schema` 3. Report insert count + range only after INSERT returns.
- Do not syncronize withdrawal transactions
